Hidden Gem 💎
Jul 2023 • Couples
We have had many meals here over our stay in Saigon. Amazing service and incredible food - for locals prices! Have tried 50% of the menu and nothing disappoints. Also ate at the other location (that we found on Google - I can't find it on trip advisor) at 42 Đ. Đề Thám, Phường Cầu Ông Lãnh, Quận 1, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh. This location has a bigger menu and amazing sugar cane juice (would highly recommend the special Saigon sugar cane juice option). Both are about a 5 minute walk from walking street and on an upper level in the building (ask any of the locals around the entrance and they'll be happy to show you the stairwell to get here. Could not recommend enough!

David Buckley
Sheffield, United Kingdom28 contributions

A peaceful hidden gem
Nov 2022 • Couples
I'm not a vegetarian but wanted to get away from the relentless meat dishes in Vietnam. The food here is delicious. My wife and I had spring rolls, braised mushrooms, braised vegan fish & white rice. Main courses were 49-59,000 dong. With drinks we paid 296,000 dong.
The restaurant has a peaceful atmosphere with gentle music playing. 
It is on the first floor and the entrance is hard to find. When you get to 35 Nguyen Van Trang there is no sign of a restaurant, just an inauspicious entrance to what seems to be a garage. Go into this entrance, and a few yards down you will see a lift and, hidden to the right of the lift, a flight of stairs. Go up to them. I'll try to post a picture of the entrance.
